sections.title: Overview
sections.content: Dreameso is a physical-element weapon used by Gustave / Verso. It scales with Agility (B), Luck (C).

sections.title: Is the Dreameso Worth Using?
sections.content: Scales off Agility (B), Luck (C). A physical-scaling weapon, so it fits any build that is not committed to a specific element.
